listing.name: Need for Speed: Carbon (Xbox 360 USA Collector's Edition) / SpeedBreaker: Carbon
listing.summary: Unofficial static recompilation of the Xbox 360 version of Need for Speed: Carbon (2006): a native port for Steam Deck, Steam Machine, Steam Frame, Linux and Mac, plus a Windows beta (iPhone/iPad: sideload the experimental IPA or build it yourself). Bring your own disc: no game files included. Not affiliated with EA or Valve.
